oct1.b11310.selectionCaveat: Prerelease; IQ4_NL memory-safety fix for CUDA/HIP/MUSA. This path requires b11310+ containing #29683. When the element count is a multiple of QK4_NL but not QK_K, the final block could read beyond the input and write beyond the output buffer; QK_K multiples are unaffected by this bug. In the author’s debug test with 192 elements, out-of-bounds writes fell from 128 to zero bytes (CUDA H20-3e and MUSA S5000); HIP shares the code but was not separately tested in that report. As reviewed on 1 October 2026, the sources announce no CVE or exploitability. This is not evidence of increased speed or changed memory requirements.

oct1.b11307.selectionCaveat: Prerelease; restores layer-input order for DFlash/DFlash2 across multiple sequences. For concurrency above one, especially with separate KV streams, use b11307+ containing #29019; the fix also accommodates tensor split. Batch splitting could deliver another token’s hidden state to the drafter; the fix restores original order. In the author’s SPEED-Bench run with Qwen3.8-27B and DFlash2, both Q4_K_M at concurrency=16, mean acceptance length rose from 3.3531 to 3.9211 (+16.94%). This does not establish end-to-end speed, Persian quality or performance on other models and hardware. Issue #27117 provides context, not confirmation that every reported case is fixed. No local runtime test; the prerelease is not a production default.

llama11532.scenario: minimum build containing both the memory-safety and ModernBERT GELU fixes
llama11532.summary: b11529+ checks the offset in ggml_acc_impl before narrowing it to int32_t to prevent overflow-induced out-of-bounds writes. The PR report also mentions negative offsets arriving via RPC GRAPH_COMPUTE; the final patch does not directly validate RPC parameters. b11532+ uses exact GELU matching Transformers for ModernBERT with hidden_activation=gelu.
llama11532.caveat: The reviewed sources announce no CVE or real-world exploitation; this fix is not evidence of a speed increase. Existing ModernBERT GGUFs need no reconversion; retest outputs from older builds. The author tested only CPU/F32 on gte-reranker-modernbert-base: maximum activation error fell from 5.8e-2 to 7.4e-6; GPU was not tested and CPU speed changes were within run-to-run noise. These figures are not a direct ModernBERT-base evaluation.
llama11532.modernbert: For llama.cpp use b11532+; older builds evaluated hidden_activation=gelu with the tanh approximation. Existing GGUFs need no reconversion; retest outputs from older builds.
b11537.scenario: minimum build containing the embedding-graph ordering fix after the mixed-batch regression
b11537.summary: Fix #30160 orders GET_ROWS before other input operations to reduce unnecessary graph splits and CPU execution. Use b11537 or newer for mixed-batch/embedding and as the starting point for retesting MTP and multi-GPU paths; verify model support separately.
b11537.caveat: One user report on Linux, SYCL and two Arc Pro B70 cards with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next / UD-IQ3_XXS: about 365 pp and 24 tg recovered to 582.23 pp and 32.75 tg. The corrected numbers were measured on the PR branch, not an independent b11537 binary test. Input details, repetition count and a separate MTP test are not fully reported; do not generalize to every GPU.
b11540.scenario: optimized MXFP4 MoE decode in the SYCL backend
b11540.summary: SYCL MXFP4 MoE optimized decode; #29809 uses arithmetic decoding and weight reordering. The author reports gpt-oss-20b on one B70 improving from 55.84 to 106.64 tok/s and gpt-oss-120b on two B70 cards from 33.27 to 67.14 tok/s.
b11540.caveat: The PR author’s original test used Windows 11, oneAPI 2026.0, an EPYC 7402P CPU and Flash Attention enabled; five repetitions for 20B and two for 120B. These are decode results; do not extrapolate to prefill, Linux or other GPUs. b11540 contains the fix, but the numbers come from the PR branch; the site has not independently tested them.
b11552.scenario: llama-server context-isolation fix for pinned id_slot with RAM prompt caching
b11552.summary: A request with a pinned id_slot now waits without loading cached context into a busy slot. Configuration requirement: pinned id_slot + RAM prompt cache → b11552+. Keep this combination out of multi-user service until upgraded and the canary acceptance test passes.
b11552.caveat: Context isolation failed; the release and PR report no CVE or real-world disclosure incident. Limited upstream test: M2 Ultra/Metal, Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M plus mmproj, --parallel 10, --kv-unified, --no-cache-idle-slots, --cache-ram 8192 and id_slot=7. b11146: 30 simultaneous pairs, 1 crossing and 9 corrupted responses. PR branch (build 11550): 60 pairs, 0 crossings and 0 corrupted responses; one round hit a 60-second client timeout. b11552 contains the fix; these are not release-binary measurements or a guarantee for every configuration. Impact without slot pinning remains unknown.

runtime1019.sglang.summary: Python ≥3.11; an unpinned install on Python 3.10 may silently select an older release. Use --attn-dp-size N instead of --enable-dp-attention; the old combination is translated with a warning. --dp-size counts replicas; DeepSeek CP temporarily retains its attention-DP meaning, to be rejected after 2026-12-31. Combining replicas with attention DP, or both spellings, fails at startup. --disaggregation-decode-host-receive-threshold reverses its encoding: 1=disabled (default), 0=always receive on host. tc_piecewise was removed; --cuda-graph-backend-prefill tc_piecewise and tc_compiler settings fail at startup.
runtime1019.sglang.caveat: Separate dates: GitHub release on 19 October 2026 at 02:55 UTC; PyPI package available since 16 October. Runtime correctness: fixes incorrect Mamba checkpoint tracking when speculative decoding and structured output are combined, which could resume hybrid models from the wrong state (PR #43029). Security: a Dumper fix is unconfirmed; the eval() path remains in tag 0.5.22. Do not treat it as fixing the earlier vulnerability. Confidence in the release, requirements and changes is high; performance and Persian quality were not tested here. This record is not an untested upgrade recommendation; OEM-specific BOM/QPLs and internal wizard code are not fully covered.

runtime1021.software-release:llama-cpp-b: LFM2 and LFM2.5-VL image preprocessing aligned with Transformers

Images are stretched to the tile grid, and resizing and dimension rounding follow the Python reference. Reconvert mmproj with the updated converter to store processor_config.json settings; b11767 changes are included.

Before the fix, layout differed for 31,926 sizes among about 16.8 million cases up to 4096×4096. In the 720×1600 example, tokens fell from 2812 to 2298. Other image shapes can increase token count and runtime. PR output tests mainly cover 450M models and the d1 family; the LFM2.5-VL-3B route remains experimental and needs tests on your images. FP4 activation precision follows model metadata
On Blackwell CUDA, NVFP4/MXFP4 layers marked W4A16 can run as W4A8. FP4 weights do not imply four-bit activations.

GGML_CUDA_MMQ_PREC=auto follows metadata; q4 and q8 override it. q4 may accelerate prompt processing at an accuracy cost, so test it before choosing a default. This change is not part of stable v0.5.0.
Long inputs for causal Qwen3 and Qwen3-VL rerankers
From b11223+ with fix #28876, RANK input with causal attention can span multiple physical batches.

Previously, input above n_ubatch, default 512 tokens, was rejected. Bidirectional cross-encoders still need one physical batch. This does not complete multimodal /rerank or /embedding support; deployment needs controlled testing.
Correct strided data reads in Vulkan
Fix #28956 corrects mul_mat and mul_mat_id reads for some strided cache and expert views.

The PR reports an endless SheetSage2 loop and a Qwen3 AR --no-fa issue. On b11224+, compare output with CPU/CUDA under matching settings and explicit numerical tolerances. Older b11160 results also need retesting. This fix does not establish a speedup or failures in every model.
Multimodal API for Qwen3-VL-Embedding
From b11240+, /v1/embeddings accepts OpenAI-style typed input; supported modalities depend on the model.

Each {"content": [...]} object produces one embedding; bare content arrays are rejected and the legacy API remains available. KV prefix reuse is disabled for embedding/rerank, so remeasure capacity and speed. The Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B/8B route is experimental and does not certify multimodal Reranker support.

b11279 introduced support in #27773; experiments also need the later fix #29745.
